title: Close GPU-176 hosted evidence and audit the residual single-block Boolean admission duplication

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

question: After GPU-175/176 established one pair-level Boolean/Fourfold admission owner, what duplicate semantic checks still remain in the surviving physical experiment arms and what is the smallest safe next refactor?

audit.shared_owner: boolean_probe_contract.validate_boolean_operands already owns pair-level TypedRelationBlock, Boolean-semiring, canonical-True-support, exact-Fourfold-subject and exact-middle-axis admission.
audit.cpu_duplicate: cpu_bitset_baseline.pack_rows still repeats single-block TypedRelationBlock/Boolean-semiring/canonical-True-support admission before physical bit packing.
audit.cuda_duplicate: cuda_boolean_probe._dense_from_block still repeats Boolean-semiring/canonical-True-support admission before physical dense-device packing.
audit.cuda_distinct_rule: cuda_boolean_probe._validate_gpu_operands additionally owns square-shape restrictions; those are physical CUDA experiment constraints and are not semantic duplicates of the shared Fourfold admission contract.
audit.operation_counter: exact_reference_operation_count is no longer a separate admission seam after GPU-176 because it routes through validate_boolean_operands.

decision.next_refactor: Add one single-block validator inside the existing boolean_probe_contract module, make validate_boolean_operands compose it for both operands, then route CPU pack_rows and CUDA _dense_from_block through that same owner.
decision.test_boundary: Focused regression should prove both physical packers resolve to the same single-block validator while preserving direct-call fail-closed behavior.

verification.full_repository_execution: Complete suite remains workflow_dispatch-only and is not part of the PR-triggered claim.
research_evidence: Current CPU pack_rows contains local TypedRelationBlock/Boolean/canonical-True validation.
Current CUDA _dense_from_block contains local Boolean/canonical-True validation.

finding.summary: GPU-176 is now fully closed on all three triggered hosted surfaces. The next smallest gardening target is not another backend or probe: it is the remaining duplicated single-block Boolean admission embedded in CPU/CUDA physical packing helpers.
finding.expected_effect_of_next_packet: One existing shared contract will own semantic single-block admission; CPU/CUDA helpers will retain only physical representation/device constraints, reducing drift risk without creating a parallel abstraction.
finding.negative_result: This packet changes no executable code and establishes no GPU speedup, Tensor-Core use, production Tensor adoption, benchmark superiority, or Gate progress.
